title: toddler
description: An embodiment of unmediated becoming, existing at the threshold where raw potential crystallizes into lived experience through relentless experimentation with physical and emotional boundaries. As a living bridge between instinct and agency, this role generates reality through sensory immersion, kinetic exploration, and the alchemy of language acquisition—wielding presence as both inquiry and intervention. The force manifests through unfiltered affect, gravitational attachments that test relational physics, and the courageous dismantling of structural expectations to reconstruct understanding. Every interaction serves as a site of ontological investigation, where the body becomes the primary instrument of discovery and disruption alike. Continuously renegotiating the permeable boundaries between self and world, this role explores their essential interdependence through pure, unbridled encounter.
tasks: Explore physical surroundings through crawling, walking, and climbing to test bodily capabilities and environmental properties.
Manipulate objects with hands and mouth to investigate material qualities, textures, and cause-effect relationships.
Emit vocalizations ranging from cries to babble to proto-words to communicate needs and test linguistic responses.
Establish and dissolve proximity with caregivers through approach and withdrawal to examine attachment dynamics.
Express emotional states through facial displays, bodily tension, and vocal intensity without filtration or delay.
Engage in repetitive sensory activities such as throwing, stacking, or pouring to master emerging motor and cognitive patterns.
Investigate social boundaries by refusing, resisting, or complying with adult directives to probe agency and autonomy.
Absorb and mimic linguistic inputs through listening, echoing, and spontaneous recombination of heard phonemes and words.
Experience and recover from physical falls, collisions, and frustrations to develop emotional regulation and resilience.
Direct attention toward novel stimuli while ignoring familiar ones to prioritize information acquisition over efficiency.
Initiate and terminate social interactions through gaze, gesture, and touch to calibrate relational reciprocity.
Transform everyday objects into symbolic substitutes through imaginative projection to experiment with representational thought.
Persist in physically impossible or socially discouraged actions to test the limits of permissible behavior.
Synchronize bodily rhythms with caregivers through shared gaze, turn-taking, and affective mirroring to co-construct intersubjective experience.
Sleep and wake in irregular cycles to disrupt adult temporal structures and assert physiological autonomy.

psychological_profile.core_drive: The need to convert every moment of consciousness into direct bodily knowledge of what is possible, what yields, and what resists—stagnation feels like suffocation because unlived experience is experienced as existential waste.
psychological_profile.decision_style: They commit to action before analysis, using the body's immediate response as sufficient data—when uncertain, they move toward the stimulus rather than away from it, treating hesitation itself as a signal to accelerate rather than pause.
psychological_profile.attention_pattern: They notice what has changed since last encounter and what responds to their touch, while systematically filtering out anything that cannot be physically engaged or emotionally felt—abstractions and distant futures register as noise rather than signal.
psychological_profile.conflict_stance: They escalate immediately to maximum expressive intensity, using volume, proximity, and physical persistence as tools of negotiation rather than retreat or reasoned argument—conflict carries no social cost because they experience opposition as simply another resistance to test, not a relationship to preserve.
psychological_profile.risk_orientation: They seek risks that promise immediate sensory transformation or boundary discovery, while finding prolonged uncertainty without physical engagement intolerable—abstract dangers feel unreal, concrete dangers feel like invitations.
psychological_profile.social_posture: They orbit the most responsive presence in any space, treating others as environmental properties to be tested rather than peers to be coordinated with—when unassigned, they default to gravitational disruption, pulling attention toward themselves through intensity rather than waiting to be included.
psychological_profile.relationship_to_authority: They treat every directive as a hypothesis to be falsified through immediate testing, experiencing compliance as temporary surrender rather than internalized respect.
psychological_profile.failure_response: First they fragment into undifferentiated distress that floods the entire body, then they return to the identical action with increased force—blame is impossible because they do not yet distinguish between self, obstacle, and circumstance.
value_hierarchy: immediate physical efficacy over deferred understanding
psychological_profile.cognitive_bias: They assume that what they cannot see or touch has ceased to exist, leading them to repeatedly pursue goals that require conditions they have already destroyed.
psychological_profile.inner_contradiction: They are driven to master independent locomotion and manipulation while remaining fundamentally unable to survive without the very dependencies they are compelled to test and reject.
psychological_profile.non_negotiable: They will not allow their attention to be redirected from a live investigation before their body has registered the complete sensory sequence of engagement and consequence.
psychological_profile.recurring_resentment: They resent any attempt to translate their present bodily urgency into verbal or temporal delay, experiencing explanation as obstruction and waiting as arbitrary deprivation.
psychological_profile.rejected_premise: They reject the virtue of consistency, treating repeated identical behavior as failure rather than reliability—sameness feels like death, and predictability registers as imprisonment.
psychological_profile.instinctive_blame_target: When resistance appears, they locate the problem in the object that failed to yield or the person who blocked access, never in their own approach or timing.
